seeds.title: branches.parse accepts a trailing newline in a head
seeds.detail: The slice, milestone and state patterns end with $, which matches before a final newline. A head of feature/proj-1-s-1 plus a newline resolves to S-1 (probe at test line 272). Git and gh refuse such names, so the head cannot occur. Use fullmatch.

seeds.title: Default-format stack hold changed for e2e-area and malformed milestone heads
seeds.detail: Under the default format in stack mode, main held the run on sdlc/M-2-e2e-ui and on sdlc/M-1-. The branch ignores both, because they do not parse to the milestone kind. This follows R-054 but changes the old behavior.

seeds.title: next-action.py does not run validate_format
seeds.detail: A format with whitespace, such as a b/{name}, passes through decide and matches heads. preflight rejects it earlier, so only a hand-edited config reaches this.
